## Change

Describe the concrete task or correction and link the original source.

## Checks

- [ ] The task/output is concrete and the source, publisher and date are recorded.
- [ ] Reposts and reused outputs are grouped with their existing case.
- [ ] Model attribution, time, selection and limitations preserve the source's meaning.
- [ ] All eleven locale files are updated, with matching case ids, media and sources.
- [ ] README generation and verification pass.
- [ ] Media and source links are checked in the rendered page.
- [ ] This collection remains usecase-only; adjacent API/skill repositories are links rather than new release artifacts.
- [ ] Source and poster/playback URLs use the approved R2 media policy.
